properties.field_evidence: Official MHCLG Planning Data listed-building-outline entity 42115018 contains an authoritative closed nonzero-area MultiPolygon for Post office, London Borough of Southwark, dated 2023-08-16, with reference and listed-building legacy identifier 470643. Historic England statutory National Heritage List entry 1378344 at 19A Borough High Street explicitly records legacy system number 470643, Grade II, first listed 27 September 1972. It identifies the building as a former St Thomas's Hospital ward block built 1842-44, later used as a Post Office. The crosswalk is official NHLE legacy ID 470643 to NHLE 1378344, not an invented equality of those separate IDs. BUILDING_PRESENT and documented historical Post office building use are supported. Contemporary postal service operation, cadastral parcel boundary, local receiver import and materialized parcel status are not asserted.
